tasks.title: Markdown body safety guard
tasks.end_state: A zero-dependency rehype plugin (src/lib/markdown-safety.ts) is registered in astro.config.mjs via markdown.rehypePlugins. It throws at build time on raw hast nodes (raw HTML, since Astro 5.18.2 hardcodes allowDangerousHtml:true and runs custom rehype plugins before rehypeRaw) and on a[href]/img[src]/* with javascript: or data: protocols. allowDangerousHtml stays default true (NOT false, which silently strips). The plugin is unit-tested (throws on raw node, on* attrs via raw, javascript:/data: links; passes safe markdown/relative/http(s) links). A fixture build test (tests/fixtures/markdown-safety/) proves astro build fails on unsafe Markdown with the guard's error message and succeeds on safe Markdown. No new dependencies. No public Markdown route ships in C1.
tasks.files_note: Declared 5-file cohesive exception: the safety guard is one cohesive unit — the plugin, its production registration, its fixture (config + unsafe page), and the unit+fixture test. Approved per .opencode/command/plan.md:340-373.
verification: RED: node --test tests/policy.test.mjs — markdown-safety tests fail (plugin stub returns no-op; unsafe fixture build currently succeeds because no guard exists). Commit: test(m2): define markdown body safety contract

GREEN: npm run check exit 0; npm test exit 0; the unsafe fixture build fails with the guard's error (raw HTML / unsafe protocol); a safe fixture build succeeds; the unit tests pass (throws on each violation class, passes safe input). Commit: feat(m2): add markdown body safety guard

tasks.title: Dynamic content route and About activation
tasks.end_state: src/pages/[page].astro uses getStaticPaths() constrained through PAGES + resolveRoutes (NOT all routable collection entries — only configured IDs; unknown public records produce no route). It calls getEntry('pages', id), throws if missing, renders via render(entry) -> <Content /> inside BaseLayout with noindex=false (public) and canonicalPath derived from the resolved route. About record (src/content/pages/about.md) ships public with honest positioning copy (title + description + one page-specific paragraph; no metrics/testimonials/dates/clients). The verifier CLI manifest adds /about/ to expectedHtmlRoutes and expectedDiscoverableRoutes, allowEmptySitemap:false. Inherited B1/B2/B3 shell tests update atomically: B1/B3 manifests add /about/; B2 nav assertion becomes 'about link present, services/contact absent'; a new C2 describe block asserts /about/ canonical/noindex-absent/sitemap-present/nav-present. No Contact, no Home record, no SiteHeader/sitemap/index/404 changes.
